question: In a certain code language, if IRONING is written as OWSQKOG, then how will SHERIFF be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The Pattern followed here is :-

IRONING is written as OWSQKOG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0945d6455f533ad8cf923fb1f82b956c84100549b236f8ee975f8bba5ac34a.png] 

Similarly,

SHERIFF is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a28881f96f091b12f8e707c2d2ffdf937942cd71701e433dce91f13919ccda4.png] 

Hence, SHERIFF is coded as **YMIUKGF**.
